name: The Gardens on El Paseo
summary: The Gardens on El Paseo is Palm Desert's premier upscale lifestyle center, featuring a bi-level open-air design with high-end retail stores and fine dining options including two steakhouses. Located on the prestigious El Paseo shopping district, this sophisticated destination serves the Coachella Valley's affluent community with curated brands and an elegant shopping atmosphere.
demographics: The Gardens on El Paseo attracts an affluent, mature demographic primarily consisting of visitors aged 45 and above with household incomes exceeding $100,000 annually. The trade area draws from Palm Desert's wealthy seasonal residents and year-round retirees, along with tourists seeking upscale shopping experiences in the Coachella Valley. Typical visitors are empty nesters and established professionals who prefer curated shopping environments with premium brands and fine dining options, reflecting the sophisticated tastes of the desert resort community.
description: The Gardens on El Paseo stands as Palm Desert's premier upscale shopping destination, offering a sophisticated bi-level open-air experience along the renowned El Paseo shopping district, often called the "Rodeo Drive of the Desert." This lifestyle center seamlessly blends high-end retail with exceptional dining, featuring upmarket chain stores alongside two distinguished steakhouses that cater to the discerning tastes of the Coachella Valley's affluent residents and visitors. The center's elegant Mediterranean-inspired architecture and meticulously landscaped grounds create an inviting atmosphere for leisurely shopping and dining in the beautiful desert climate. With its carefully curated tenant mix and prime location on El Paseo, The Gardens has established itself as a cornerstone of Palm Desert's luxury retail scene, attracting both seasonal residents and year-round locals seeking premium brands and refined experiences. The center's commitment to providing an elevated shopping environment is reflected in its 4.6-star rating from over 1,000 reviews, demonstrating its consistent appeal to sophisticated shoppers who appreciate quality, service, and ambiance.
